ترتبطون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَبِطُونَ (tartabiṭūna) /tar.ta.bi.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# تُرْتَبَطُونَ (turtabaṭūna) /tur.ta.ba.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
